review_description: Max Fox Electrical - Inland Solar reviewed our current PV system, power usage and my thoughts on available systems and provided a comprehensive quote and realistic install time.We needed reposition 6yo panels, 5.28kW new panels, new Sigenergy 16kWh battery system with inverter and Gateway HomeMax.Installation was in reasonable time with great staff and advice during and after install. They even added in our new EV charger that arrived mid install.Everything was explained after install including the new App and how we can customise our settings.

Major aims are for carbon reduction and local manufacture and installation. They were happy to custom build to my specs using top quality gear. Design, installation, setup and after sales support (helped me diagnose and tweak my programming for nix) all easy and exceptional. My choice of premium gear added nil significant cost to labour and gives me a very solid system with comprehensive programming, usage and monitoring options. I’m a tough marker, but 16 months later I can’t fault these guys or the gear.

This is a local Tamworth Company with a good track record of service in several sectors of the electrical industry. The products they offered were all of reasonable to good quality according to your web site. Installation was quick and efficient and the staff were professional in their conduct.
